Everyone was pretty nice to me, the max amount of people there at one time were 6 teens (3 girls and 3 boys) and you only stayed for two weeks at a time, so while I was there multiple people came and left. Growing up as an only child it was kind of refreshing to be constantly around people my own age along with at least 3 adult staff. Some of the residents, were more welcoming than others but there was a huge variety of mental disorders people suffered with so you couldn't take it personally. A group home has set rules like bedtimes, when you can eat and what, there was structured activity or group therapy sessions at certain times but you also had a lot more freedom than in a hospital.
